name: machinery-register-customform
description: Google Apps Script (V8) + TypeScript (clasp) 大平テック機械台帳入力フォーム

scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:empty
scripts.deploy:gas:dev: npm run push && clasp deploy -i <DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ID> -d "dev deploy"
scripts.deploy:gas:prod: npm run push && clasp deploy -i <PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ID> -d "prod deploy"
